name: corridor-monorepo
description: Corridor: 100% Offline, Pure-TypeScript Autonomous Drone Airspace (UTM), 4D Conflict Resolution & Airspace Clearing Monorepo

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/domain-core packages/crypto-auth packages/event-bus packages/spatial-index packages/corridor-lock packages/ledger-engine apps/drone-fleet-simulator apps/telemetry-ingestor apps/spoof-detector apps/airspace-controller apps/flight-plan-saga apps/billing-settlement apps/control-plane-api
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['packages','apps']) { for (const d of fs.readdirSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p+'/'+d+'/dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); }"
